plans.idea: Centred poster lockup like the original: a large text block centred on the canvas, so the two-line headline is the dominant focal point and the subheadline sits close beneath it, with even whitespace all round.

Left-aligned editorial block, vertically centred: the text owns the left two-thirds at full height, so the headline sets large and flush-left on a strong left edge, and the open right third reads as deliberate negative space rather than leftover space.

Banner-width band: a wide, shallow text box across the vertical centre lets the headline run as one or two long lines that read left to right, with the subheadline as a tagline under it, using the landscape width rather than stacking narrowly.
